segment.description: Upper Ocoee River, Copperhill reach, Polk County: from Copperhill (which sits at the upper end of TVA's Ocoee No. 3 impoundment — TVA says that reservoir stretches ~11 miles upriver to the Tennessee-Georgia state line) through Ocoee Number Three Lake and the No. 3/No. 2 gorge to the Parksville Lake head. Reach discipline: the middle Ocoee whitewater corridor below Ocoee Dam No. 2 and the Parksville/Ocoee No. 1 tailwater are separate catalog waters (documented in another batch) — their facts are not transferred here. USGS 03559500 (identity verified: 'OCOEE RIVER AT COPPERHILL, TN', gage elevation 1,445.1 ft, drainage 352 sq mi) sits in the upper pool at Copperhill.
segment.boundaries: Copperhill/TN-GA line downstream through the Ocoee No. 3 impoundment and the Ocoee No. 3 / No. 2 dam gorge to the head of Parksville Reservoir (Ocoee Dam No. 1 pool), Polk County.

damTailwater.dam: Ocoee Dam No. 3 (upstream impoundment boundary; TVA diverts water from the dam through a tunnel to a powerhouse more than two miles downstream)

coldSource.notes: Elevation is the USGS gage datum for 03559500 at Copperhill. TVA's Ocoee No. 3 page: 110-ft-high, 612-ft-long dam (built 1941-42), 360-acre reservoir, water 'diverted ... and sluiced from the dam on selected days' with releases partly timed for whitewater recreation — flow in the gorge is release-dependent. No measured water temperature found: 03559500 records only streamflow/gage height (July 2025 IV query empty), and TVA powerhouse gauge 03562551 ('OCOEE R AT OCOEE NO 3 PWERHOUSE') returned no retrievable temperature series in IV/DV queries.

holdover.detail: Nothing resolved. No agency stocking or carryover record exists for the upper Ocoee: TWRA's live trout page and stocking dataset contain only 'Parksville(Ocoee #1) TW / Ocoee River' (tailwater below Ocoee Dam No. 1, March-May rainbow) and Parksville in the reservoir list — no upper-Ocoee/Copperhill entry. Outfitter claims that TWRA stocks the upper Ocoee were found only on guide-marketing pages and are not acceptable as sole evidence; they are leads only.

wildPopulation.detail: No agency record of a wild trout population in the Copperhill reach found.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: No agency stocking or temperature record resolves for the Copperhill reach, and TVA's tunnel diversion makes flow (and any cold-water refugia) release-dependent — the habitat question is simply undocumented in the sources checked.

sourcesChecked: repo-local TWRA stocking schedule snapshot packages/content/data/twra-stocking-schedule.json (only Ocoee row: Parksville(Ocoee #1) TW, months M,A,M, rainbow)
